title: Minimum rival covers for 108 RNA-Undesign motifs
description: For 108 fixed RNA-Undesign motif instances, this dataset records the minimum number of rival structures needed to rule out a unique minimum-energy target for every target-compatible sequence under fixed boundaries, fixed AAA boundary interiors and the specified candidate set, using ViennaRNA 2.7.2 with Turner 2004 parameters at 37 C and dangles=2. Ties count against uniqueness. The minima range from one to six. Upper-cover and lower-witness certificates and verification software allow these finite results to be checked. The original motif data are retrieved separately from the pinned source; source-data permissions and licensing are described in README.md and LICENSE.
